name: Spacious melodic-techno four
desc: Melodic-techno kit built on negative space: dry 909 four, rim ticks on the off-eighths, and one enormous reverb-tail clap that only lands on beat 3 of every other bar. No hat wash — the air between hits is the instrument. Afterlife/Innervisions stage weather; peak brings a soft ride and doubles the rims.

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("[~ rim]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(".26 .14 .22 .16").iter(8), s("<~ [~ ~ cp ~]>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.5).room(${air}), s("sh(3,16,<0 4 8 12>)").gain(.18)).lastOf(8, x=>x.mask("[1 1 1 0]")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.4).gain(${gain}), s("[~ rim]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(".3 .16 .26 .18").iter(16).ply("<1 1 1 2>"), s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.52).room(${air}), s("rd*4").gain(".22 .12 .18 .12").late("[0 .02]*2"), s("sh(5,16,<0 3 6 9>)").gain(.2)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
